newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices rise on world trends.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices rise on world trends.

text.p: Gold prices jumped on Istanbul's gold bourse on Tuesday partly reflecting some mild free market demand, dealers said.
Traded volume, all in lira terms, dropped to 702 kilos from Monday's 1,067. Gold closed up 4,800 lira at 1,143,200 lira per gram.
Dealers said a weak lira against the dollar in the free currency market also helped to raise gold prices.
Cash dollars traded at 93,000 lira in the free market, up from yesterday's 92,700 due to demand for the U.S. currency despite a lower dollar/mark parity.
On broker expected gold trade to fade as jewellers and foreign exchange and gold shops in the free market channelled their funds to Treasury-bills ahead of the weekend.
The treasury sold a record 288 trillion lira 238-d t-bills in today's auction at slightly lower yields.
